input: Research Tesla (tesla.com) for a hedge fund

catalysts.claim: Fiscal.ai estimates Tesla's Q4 2026 trading update for 2027-01-02; status is estimated, so the date can move.
Fiscal.ai estimates Tesla's FY2026 earnings release and earnings call for 2027-01-27 after close, with the periodic report estimated for 2027-01-28.
Fiscal.ai estimates Tesla's Q1 2027 trading update for 2027-04-02 and its Q1 2027 earnings release/call for 2027-04-21 after close; these dates are estimated.

Tesla's 10-Q says SpaceX shares remain subject to customary sales restrictions connected with the SpaceX IPO that expire in December 2026, creating a potentially material near-term mark-to-market/liquidity event around the related investment.

results_vs_guidance.claim: Q3 2026 revenue was $28.046 billion versus Tesla's company-compiled consensus average of $28.341 billion and median of $28.264 billion; GAAP operating income was $718 million versus an average $721 million and median $687 million.
Q3 2026 GAAP diluted EPS was $0.22 versus company-compiled consensus of $0.23 average/$0.21 median; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.48 versus $0.45 average and median consensus.

Q3 2026 free cash flow was $1.531 billion, versus company-compiled consensus of negative $4.506 billion average and negative $4.385 billion median; cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were $45.447 billion versus consensus of $39.009 billion average/$39.087 billion median.

The current explicit numeric company outlook opened here is 2026 capital expenditures in excess of $20 billion, driven by Super Intelligence compute/data centers, manufacturing and R&D facilities, company-operated SI-enabled assets, and retail/service/charging infrastructure.

event_driven.claim: Tesla's board formed a special committee of disinterested directors to explore deepening Tesla's relationship with SpaceX, including potentially a business combination; Tesla states there is no assurance a transaction will occur and shareholder approval may be required.
Tesla invested $2.00 billion in SpaceX common stock in March 2026, representing less than 1% ownership, and recorded a $142 million Q3 loss and $863 million nine-month gain on the SpaceX investment.

Tesla acquired a Super Intelligence hardware company in Q2 2026 for $1.95 billion in Tesla common stock and equity awards; $1.73 billion is subject to service conditions and/or performance milestones.

credit_signals.claim: As of 2026-09-30, Tesla reported $9.284 billion of aggregate debt, including $1.311 billion current debt, and $30.0 billion of unused committed amounts under senior unsecured credit facilities; Tesla said it was in material compliance with financial debt covenants.

On 2026-09-29, Tesla entered a $20.0 billion senior unsecured delayed-draw term loan facility maturing 2029-09-29; undrawn commitments step down to $10.0 billion at 12 months, $5.0 billion at 15 months and zero at 18 months after closing.

The same refinancing added an $8.0 billion five-year revolver due 2031-09-29 and a $2.0 billion 364-day revolver due 2027-09-28, replacing the prior $5.0 billion revolver due January 2028; Tesla said no loans were outstanding under the new facilities at closing and did not plan to draw them in 2026.

As of 2026-09-30, Tesla had $17.85 billion of cash and cash equivalents, $27.59 billion of short-term investments, $1.62 billion of unused letters of credit outstanding and stated that current and potential funding sources provided adequate liquidity for the following 12 months and long term.

alternative_signals.claim: Tesla said Q3 FSD (Supervised) attach rate exceeded 75% of new vehicle deliveries in North America, nearly 20 percentage points higher sequentially, and active FSD subscriptions reached 1.74 million versus 1.48 million in Q2.

Tesla reported its largest passenger-vehicle backlog in four years, but said battery availability remained the limiting factor on increasing auto volumes; Q3 deliveries were 486,532 and production was 464,391.

Tesla began volume production of the updated Tesla Semi on a high-volume Nevada line, began production at Megafactory Texas with planned capacity of 50 GWh, and began early-ramp Optimus production on high-volume Fremont lines.

Q3 operating expenses rose 39% year over year to $4.776 billion while operating income fell 56% year over year to $718 million; the spending burden is concentrated in the SI/AI, robotics and growth build-out described in Tesla's filing.

insider_and_ownership.claim: Tesla CFO Vaibhav Taneja's Form 4 reports 6,539 shares acquired on 2026-09-05 through RSU vesting and 2,605.75 shares sold on 2026-09-08 at $360.134; the filing identifies the sale as direct ownership and tax-related withholding, not an open-market investment sale.
Tesla's Q3 2026 10-Q states that no Tesla director or officer adopted, modified or terminated a Rule 10b5-1 or non-Rule 10b5-1 trading arrangement during the quarter ended 2026-09-30.

The recent SEC filing query opened for Tesla from 2026-09-01 through 2026-11-10 returned one Form 4 and no 13D/13G filings in that window; no current institutional position change was verified from an opened Tesla-specific filing.

risks.claim: Tesla's Q3 revenue was essentially flat year over year, GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders fell 43% to $787 million, and operating margin was 2.6% versus 5.8% a year earlier, leaving valuation highly dependent on future autonomy, robotics and energy execution.

Tesla expects 2026 capex above $20 billion, while its filing says periods of heightened capex, rising material prices and supply-chain/labor costs may require funding beyond operating cash flow and could lead to additional debt or financing.

Tesla disclosed ongoing requests and investigations involving NHTSA, NTSB, SEC, DOJ and other authorities concerning vehicle functionality, incidents, driver assistance, Robotaxi, compliance, finance, data privacy and related parties; it said an enforcement action could materially harm business, cash flows, financial position or brand.

Tesla disclosed multiple litigation exposures involving alleged Autopilot/FSD/Robotaxi misrepresentations, discrimination and product claims; a Ninth Circuit decision on 2026-10-16 vacated a limited California consumer class certification, but the case returned to the district court and other matters remain active.
Tesla said battery availability limited auto-volume growth, while tariffs, changes in incentives and the OBBBA could increase battery costs and reduce consumer demand for energy products.

output.research_view: The near-term trade is a test of whether Cybercab/FSD, Semi, Optimus and Megapack milestones can convert into durable revenue and margin growth before Q4 results; Q3 showed strong cash generation and demand/backlog signals, but the core P&L still has flat revenue, 2.6% operating margin and sharply higher operating expense. The largest event risk is strategic: Tesla's SpaceX special committee could create major optionality but also governance, dilution, related-party and capital-allocation uncertainty; the next hard catalysts are the estimated January 2027 Q4/FY2026 reporting cycle and the 2026 capex/financing trajectory. Sources: https://assets-ir.tesla.com/tesla-contents/IR/TSLA-Q3-2026-Update.pdf; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066775/tsla-20260930.htm; https://ir.tesla.com/sec-filings
